verses.translation: A Psalm of instruction for David, when he was in the cave,—a Prayer.

translations.ron: Cu glasul meu către Domnul am strigat, cu glasul meu către Domnul m-am rugat.
translations.grk: Συνέσεως τῷ Δαυὶδ, ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ, προσευχή.

verses.translation: I cried to the Lord with my voice; with my voice I made supplication to the Lord.

translations.ron: Vărsa-voi înaintea Lui rugăciunea mea, necazul meu înaintea Lui voi spune.
translations.grk: Φωνῇ μου πρὸς Κύριον ἐκέκραξα, φωνῇ μου πρὸς Κύριον ἐδεήθην.

verses.translation: I will pour out before him my supplication: I will declare before him mine affliction.

translations.ron: Când lipsea dintru mine duhul meu, Tu ai cunoscut cărările mele. În calea aceasta în care am umblat, ascuns-au cursă mie.
translations.grk: Ἐκχεῶ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ τὴν δέησίν μου, τὴν θλίψιν μου ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἀπαγγελῶ.

verses.translation: When my spirit was fainting within me, then thou knewest my paths; in the very way wherein I was walking, they hid a snare for me.

translations.ron: Luat-am seama de-a dreapta şi am privit şi nu era cine să mă cunoască. Pierit-a fuga de la mine şi nu este cel ce caută sufletul meu.
translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ ἐκλείπειν ἐξ ἐμοῦ τὸ πνεῦμά μου, καὶ σὺ ἔγνως τὰς τρίβους μου· ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ ἐπορευόμην, ἔκρυψαν παγίδα μοι.

verses.translation: I looked on my right hand, and behold, for there was none that noticed me; refuge failed me; and there was none that cared for my soul.

translations.ron: Strigat-am către Tine, Doamne, zis-am: "Tu eşti nădejdea mea, partea mea eşti în pământul celor vii".
translations.grk: Κατενόουν εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ καὶ ἐπέβλεπον, ὅτι οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐπιγινώσκων με· ἀπώλετο φυγὴ ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐκζητῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου.

verses.translation: I cried unto thee, O Lord, and said, Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.

translations.ron: Ia aminte la rugăciunea mea, că m-am smerit foarte. Izbăveşte-mă de cei ce mă prigonesc, că s-au întărit mai mult decât mine.
translations.grk: Πρὸς σὲ, Κύριε, ἐκέραξα, καὶ εἶπα, σὺ εἶ ἡ ἐλπίς μου, μερίς μου ἐν γῇ ζώντων.

verses.translation: Attend to my supplication, for I am brought very low; deliver me from them that persecute me; for they are stronger than I.

translations.ron: Scoate din temniţă sufletul meu, ca să laude numele Tău, Doamne. Pe mine mă aşteaptă drepţii, până ce-mi vei răsplăti mie.
translations.grk: Πρόσχες πρὸς τὴν δέησίν μου, ὅτι ἐταπεινώθην σφόδρα· ῥῦσαί με ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με, ὅτι ἐκραταιώθησαν ὑπὲρ ἐμέ.

verses.translation: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to thy name, O Lord; the righteous shall wait for me, until thou recompense me.

translations.grk: Ἐξάγαγε ἐκ φυλακῆς τὴν ψυχήν μου, τοῦ ἐξομολογήσασθαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου, Κύριε· ἐμὲ ὑπομενοῦσι δίκαιοι, ἕως οὗ ἀνταποδῷς μοι.
